title: Utilization Management Program Case Intake Terms
content:
These terms of the Utilization Management Program state who may open a coverage review case and how requests reach Northbridge Rx. They are the same on all six review packages.

| Term | Northbridge Clinical Essentials | Northbridge Clinical Standard | Northbridge Clinical Advanced | Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A member or authorized representative may open a review (the prescriber's clinical information is still required) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| At most one undecided case per member, drug and review type | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The requester may withdraw an undecided case | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Electronic prior authorization from the prescriber's system is accepted | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A denial lists the formulary alternatives that need no review | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### What the terms mean for a request

- A member may open a case in their own name, but the case is decided on the prescriber's clinical information whoever opened it.
- A second case for the same drug and the same review type cannot sit undecided beside the first; a case for the same drug under a different review type is a separate matter.
- A withdrawal is open to the requester only while the case is undecided.
